findings.reason: The embedded title with a colon runs directly into the object of the verb, making the sentence hard to parse; the title should be set off (quotes or an introducing noun).
'branded content' is rendered incompletely here (elsewhere correctly as محتوى العلامات التجارية), creating an inconsistent and truncated term.
Gender agreement error: 'البيانات' is feminine plural and requires the feminine verb form 'تتدفق'.

findings.span: تتضمن MarkdownNote لشرح سير العمل مع نصائح استخدام
findings.suggestion: تتضمن MarkdownNote لشرح الرسم البياني مع نصائح استخدام
findings.reason: The English says 'annotate the graph'; 'graph' is rendered as 'الرسم البياني' everywhere else in this entry, so using 'سير العمل' (workflow) here is both an accuracy shift and an internal inconsistency.
'prompt' is consistently rendered as 'مطالبة' throughout the page (description, extendedDescription, FAQ); using 'موجهات' here breaks terminology consistency.
Glossary requires 'this workflow' → 'سير العمل هذا'; the demonstrative placed before the noun phrase ('هذا سير العمل') is also ambiguous in Arabic (reads as 'this is the workflow').
Same glossary term 'this workflow' → 'سير العمل هذا'; keeps FAQ consistent with the rest of the page.

findings.span: Seedance 2.0 - Extend Video هو سير عمل ComfyUI
findings.suggestion: Seedance 2.0 - تمديد الفيديو هو سير عمل ComfyUI
findings.reason: The workflow title is translated in the title field but left in English here, creating an inconsistency across the page.
'prompt' is rendered as 'الموجه النصي' in the description but as 'مطالبة' here and in the FAQ; terminology should be consistent across the entry.
'render' is translated as 'العرض' (display/view), which does not convey the rendering/output-generation sense.

findings.suggestion: أدرج الرسم البياني في قائمة الانتظار
findings.reason: UI term 'Graph' must be rendered as 'الرسم البياني' per the required glossary.
'loop' is translated as 'الحلقات' at the start of the same sentence but left in Latin script here, an inconsistent mix within one item.

'Outpainting' is rendered as 'التوسيع الخارجي' in the description, metaDescription and howToUse, but as 'التمديد خارج الإطار' here and in the FAQ; the same term must be used consistently across the page.
Inconsistent rendering of 'outpainting' compared with the description/metaDescription/howToUse, which use 'التوسيع الخارجي'.

findings.suggestion: لتعديل الصور عالي الجودة / لتحرير صور عالية الجودة
findings.reason: Adjective-noun agreement error: 'صور' (plural feminine) does not agree with 'عالي'; a native speaker would write 'عالية الجودة' or restructure the phrase.
'تقاد' (is led/driven) is an unnatural passive rendering of 'is driven by' in this technical context.
The generic term 'diffusion' (not part of a protected product name here) is left in Latin script inside Arabic prose; it should be rendered in Arabic, optionally with the English in parentheses.
Inconsistent rendering of 'checkpoint': translated as نقطة تحقق here but kept as 'checkpoint' in the FAQ answer on the same page.
Inconsistent rendering of 'denoise strength': translated as قوة إزالة الضجيج in howToUse but left in English here.

findings.span: التراكبات المتحركة أو المتحركة الرسومية أو الكبيرة المساحة
findings.suggestion: التراكبات المتحركة أو المتحرّكة رسوميًا أو ذات المساحة الكبيرة
findings.reason: Awkward and repetitive phrasing; 'المتحركة الرسومية' and 'الكبيرة المساحة' are not natural Arabic adjective constructions.

findings.span: قم بالتحميل والمعالجة وحفظ لقطات نظيفة
findings.suggestion: قم بالتحميل والمعالجة وحفظ اللقطات النظيفة
findings.reason: Coordination is grammatically inconsistent: two verbal nouns after قم بـ followed by a construct with an indefinite object reads unnatural.
Generic English word 'stock' left in Latin script mid-sentence; same issue with 'timecode' in the first use case.
The required product-UI term list specifies Gemini must be rendered as 'جيميني'; it was left in Latin script here.

findings.span: تجمع ImageBatchMulti لقطة ثابتة واحدة أو أكثر في دفعة
findings.suggestion: تجمع ImageBatchMulti لقطة ثابتة مختارة واحدة أو أكثر في دفعة
findings.reason: The English says 'one or more selected stills'; the qualifier 'selected' is omitted in the translation.
Inconsistent terminology within the page: 'casting' is rendered as 'اختيار المواهب' in the title and use cases but transliterated as 'كاستينغ' here and in howToUse.
'Preset' is rendered as 'الإعدادات الجاهزة' in the metaDescription, extendedDescription and howToUse, but as 'مُعد مسبقًا' here; inconsistent terminology across the same page.
Same 'preset' inconsistency: elsewhere the page uses 'الإعدادات الجاهزة'.
Repetition of 'مثل' twice in a row ('e.g., keys like') reads awkwardly; a native writer would avoid the duplication.
Colloquial transliteration 'السوشيال' is too informal for published SEO copy; standard Arabic term should be used.
'الستايل' is an informal transliteration of 'style'; standard Arabic wording is preferable in formal copy.
The adjective 'الدقيقة' attaches to 'الحزمة' instead of 'name', making the phrase ambiguous compared to 'the exact repository or package name'.
